articles.title: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Reports Longer Survival In Advanced Kidney Cancer Trial
articles.summary: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) reported new trial data showing Votrient plus Roche's Avastin improved overall survival in certain advanced kidney cancer patients. The combination delivered overall survival outcomes much greater than Votrient alone in newly diagnosed advanced kidney cancer cases. In favorable risk patients, survival results on Votrient plus Avastin were comparable or superior to some newer immunotherapy regimens at a lower cost.
